profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Muck Rack
profile.geoLocationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
profile.summary: Senior Software Developer with 10+ years of experience in frontend and full-stack web development. Proven track record of leading projects that increase user engagement and revenue. Skilled in React, TypeScript, and responsive design, with a passion for creating intuitive, user-friendly interfaces. Experienced in optimizing performance and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality web applications.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer I
positions.description: Quickly advanced to Senior Software Engineer by leading various commerce projects, including optimizing our product database that resulted in increased revenue and mentoring junior developers.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description: Improved team efficiency by sharing my front-end experience to guide other developers with regards to front-end projects.

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description: After being promoted, I assumed the role of tech lead, guiding and mentoring new developers through structured code reviews. I also led more projects relating to SEO optimization and creating new features to improve user engagement.

positions.title: Front End Developer
positions.description:
Increased my knowledge of front-end development by leading the migration of an outdated, non-responsive website to a responsive platform using React and styled-components. I also increased my team productivity by expanding skills into full-stack development by actively collaborating on Django
views and models.

positions.title: Commercial Web Developer
positions.description: Created high-performing ad creatives using JavaScript and CSS within DFP, tailored to diverse client needs, including million-dollar ad campaigns. I also led a cross-functional initiative to optimize mobile ad viewability, achieving a 60% improvement in performance metrics and enhancing user engagement.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · DoubleClick for Publishers (DFP) · CSS · jQuery · Front-End Development

positions.title: Front/Back End Developer
positions.description: Gained foundational experience in web development by adding new features such as sorting gym passes by distance according to the user's current location; signing up or signing in using Facebook and Twitter.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · Back-End Web Development

volunteerExperiences.description: It's a very rewarding experience to be able to mentor incoming first-years and providing them with valuable tips and advice on various issues. It is more than just teaching how to study for exams or what class to take, it is about providing ways to be safe in any environment.
